connect.title: Connect this phone
connect.sub: Enter this code on pr.social in Tools. The phone will connect automatically.
connect.path: On pr.social: Tools → Surfing app → enter the code.
connect.expired.sub: A code is valid for ten minutes. Get a new one.
connect.fail.network: No connection to pr.social. The app will try again automatically when the internet is back.
connect.fail.often: Too many codes were requested from this network. Try again in {min} min.
connect.fail.busy: pr.social is busy. Try again in a minute.
connect.fail.other: pr.social did not respond. Try again.
connect.done.title: Connected
connect.done: This phone is now connected to @{user}.
connect.off.sub: It was removed from your account on pr.social. Use the new code below to connect it again.
connect.no.tasks: A phone can be connected after {need} approved tasks. Complete tasks on pr.social, then enter this code again.
connect.no.devices: Your account already has {max} devices connected. Disconnect one on pr.social in Tools, then enter this code again.
connect.no.device: This phone cannot be connected. Install the app only from pr.social. Emulators and rooted phones are not supported.
connect.no.restricted: Your account is restricted. The phone can be connected once the restriction is lifted.
connect.no.off: The Surfing app is not available for your account yet.
stats.title: Statistics
limits.title: Limits
limits.hour.hint: How many sites this phone can show in an hour
limits.day.hint: How many sites your whole account can show in a day, all devices combined
home.week.bars: This phone's earnings over the last 7 days
home.ready: Sites open by themselves, one after another, while the app is open on the screen. The screen stays on and dims.
home.notready: Sites will start once this is fixed
home.need.wifi: Connect to Wi-Fi or allow mobile data
home.need.internet: No internet: connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data
home.need.charger: Connect the charger or allow showing on battery
home.need.battery: Charge the phone: the battery is below 20%
home.need.cool: The phone is too warm: sites will start once it cools down
home.journal.hint: Every site shown and whether it counted
home.update.hint: It installs over this version in about a minute. Your account and earnings are kept.
home.update.allow: Android needs your permission to install apps from PR Surf. Allow it and come back: the installer will open automatically.
home.update.failed.network: The download was interrupted. Check your internet connection and try again.
home.update.failed.space: Not enough storage on the phone. Free up some space and try again.
home.update.failed.site: The update could not be downloaded. Try again in a few minutes.
gate.blocked.sub: PR.SOCIAL has blocked this phone. Write to Support to find out why and what to do.
gate.restricted.sub: Surfing is paused while the restriction lasts. Support can tell you why.
gate.update.sub: This version no longer works. The new one installs in about a minute, and your account and earnings are kept.
gate.closed.sub: The app checks on its own, so there is nothing you need to do. When surfing is available again, the start button will return.
fix.vpn.sub: Some orders only count visitors without a VPN. Turn off the VPN to get more sites.
wait.empty.sub: New sites appear when advertisers order visits. Next check at {time}. Keep the app open.
wait.busy.sub: Showing will continue at {time}. Sites already shown are not lost.
wait.network.sub: Next try at {time}. Sites already shown are not lost.
pause.screen.sub: Showing will continue when you return to the app.
pause.person.sub: Tap Continue when you are ready.
pause.no_wifi.sub: Sites are shown only on Wi-Fi. Connect to Wi-Fi or allow mobile data.
pause.no_charger.sub: Sites are shown only while the phone is charging.
pause.low_battery.sub: Connect the charger, and showing will continue automatically.
pause.hot.sub: Showing will continue once it cools down.
pause.no_internet.sub: Showing will continue when the connection is back.
pause.check_missed.sub: “Are you there?” was not answered in time. Tap Continue to resume.
check.title: Are you there?
check.sub: Tap the button below to continue. Showing is paused until you answer.
stop.ask.sub: Sites already shown will still count.
journal.title: History
journal.empty.title: Nothing yet
journal.empty: Sites the app shows will appear here, each marked as counted or not.
why.LOAD: The site did not open. The problem is on the site's side, not yours.
why.DNS: The site's address no longer works. There is nothing you need to do.
why.TIMEOUT: The site took too long to load. It may be slow, or the connection may be weak: Wi-Fi usually helps.
why.HTTP: The site responded with an error. There is nothing you need to do.
why.SSL: The site's security certificate is not valid, so the app did not open it.
why.BLOCKED: The site's protection did not let the app open the page.
why.VIDEO: The video did not start: it may have been removed or made private.
why.CRASH: The app's browser stopped on this page and restarted.
why.EARLY: The app reported this site sooner than its viewing time allows. Keep the date and time on your phone set to automatic.
why.SHORT: The page was not on the screen long enough. Keep the app open and the screen on.
why.VIDEO_SHORT: The video did not play long enough: an ad or a pause took up the time.
why.CONTROL: This was a pr.social check page, and it was not shown correctly.
why.NOT_SHOWN: Showing stopped before it was this site's turn.
why.RESTRICTED: Your account is restricted: sites are not counted until the restriction is lifted.
why.GONE: The app reported this site too late: it was closed for a long time.
why.OTHER: pr.social did not count this site.
settings.title: Settings
settings.wifi.hint: Sites and videos will not use mobile data
settings.charging.hint: The screen stays on, so this saves your battery
settings.dim.hint: A minute after your last touch, the screen dims and showing continues
settings.support.hint: Questions about the app or your earnings
settings.account.hint: This phone is connected to this account
settings.disconnect.ask: This phone will no longer be connected to @{user}. You can connect it again with a new code.
toast.busy: pr.social is busy. Try again in a minute.
toast.mobile: Mobile data is allowed. You can change this in Settings.
toast.nocharger: Sites will now be shown on battery too. You can change this in Settings.
toast.nobrowser: No browser found to open pr.social
toast.noupdate: The new version is not ready yet. Try again later.
toast.still.update: The app still needs an update
settings.mini.hint: When you leave the app, the sites go on in a small window over other apps
settings.mini.none: This phone does not support a small window
settings.mini.denied: Picture-in-picture is turned off for PR Surf in the phone's settings
home.mini: You can use other apps meanwhile: the sites go on in a small window.
show.resumed: Showing continued from where it stopped
notify.stopped.sub: Tap to continue: the sites will go on from where they stopped.
skip.title: Skip this site?
skip.sub: It will not count, and it will not be shown to you again.
skip.done: Skipped. The next site is opening.
